# Agent tools

The eight model-facing tools that the MCP bridge (`bhms mcp`), the OpenAI adapter (`bhms.bridges.openai_tools.tools_for_openai`) and the CLI serve, with the exact descriptions and input schemas a model receives ([spec 12](../../../spec/bhms/12-agent-surface.md)). `bhms_run_program` is listed only when the server advertises `programs`.

| Tool | MCP hints | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`bhms_find`](#bhms_find) | readOnlyHint=true, idempotentHint=true | Find devices (and saved programs) by text, capability, tag or status; with no arguments it lists every device. |
| [`bhms_describe`](#bhms_describe) | readOnlyHint=true, idempotentHint=true | Describe one device: its actions with argument units and bounds, properties, effects, lease and stop behaviour. |
| [`bhms_read`](#bhms_read) | readOnlyHint=true | Read a device property. |
| [`bhms_invoke`](#bhms_invoke) | readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, idempotentHint=false | Invoke a device action and wait up to wait_ms for the outcome. |
| [`bhms_operation`](#bhms_operation) | readOnlyHint=true, idempotentHint=true | Get an operation's current state, or wait up to wait_ms for it to settle. |
| [`bhms_cancel`](#bhms_cancel) | readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, idempotentHint=true | Ask one operation to stop. |
| [`bhms_stop`](#bhms_stop) | readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, idempotentHint=true | Stop devices now: runs their stop procedure, ends their operations and revokes their leases. |
| [`bhms_run_program`](#bhms_run_program) | readOnlyHint=false, destructiveHint=true, idempotentHint=false | Run a bounded program (inline or by program_digest from bhms_find) as one operation. |

## bhms_find

Find devices (and saved programs) by text, capability, tag or status; with no arguments it lists every device. Start here.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | no | Words; a device matches when any word occurs in its id, name, summary, tags or capabilities. |
| `capability` | string | no | Capability id, a prefix ending in .*, or * for any |
| `tag` | string | no | Free-form label. |
| `status` | "online" \| "offline" \| "degraded" \| "unknown" | no |  |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque server-minted cursor. |

## bhms_describe

Describe one device: its actions with argument units and bounds, properties, effects, lease and stop behaviour. Give exactly one of device_id or topic.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | string | no | Device identifier. |
| `topic` | "program-grammar" | no | A guide instead of a device: program-grammar is the bhms_run_program format. |

## bhms_read

Read a device property. The result says how the value was obtained (measured, reported, commanded...), its quality and age. Without max_age_ms the bridge asks for a reading at most 1000 ms old.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | string | yes | Device identifier. |
| `property` | string | yes | Action, property or program name (snake_case). |
| `max_age_ms` | integer | no | Maximum acceptable age. |
| `fresh` | boolean | no | Require a new measurement. |

## bhms_invoke

Invoke a device action and wait up to wait_ms for the outcome. Pass operation_key when you may retry; after a timeout call bhms_operation, or repeat this call with the SAME operation_key and identical arguments: it returns the original operation instead of acting twice.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | string | yes | Device identifier. |
| `action` | string | yes | Action, property or program name (snake_case). |
| `arguments` | object | yes | Arguments per the action's input schema; numbers in the declared unit, or {value, unit}. |
| `operation_key` | string | no | Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same key with identical arguments to retry safely. |
| `wait_ms` | integer | no | Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000). |
| `require_verified` | boolean | no | Fail unless the effect is verified by measurement. |

## bhms_operation

Get an operation's current state, or wait up to wait_ms for it to settle. Use this instead of re-invoking.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation_id` | string | yes | Opaque server-minted identifier (operationId, leaseId). |
| `wait_ms` | integer | no | Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000). |

## bhms_cancel

Ask one operation to stop. Cancellation is a request: check the returned cancel.state. Use bhms_stop to halt a device.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `operation_id` | string | yes | Opaque server-minted identifier (operationId, leaseId). |
| `reason` | string | no |  |

## bhms_stop

Stop devices now: runs their stop procedure, ends their operations and revokes their leases. The safe action when something goes wrong. Not an emergency stop. Give exactly one of device_ids or all.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device_ids` | array of string | no |  |
| `all` | true | no |  |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |

## bhms_run_program

Run a bounded program (inline or by program_digest from bhms_find) as one operation. The whole program is validated before any step runs. Give exactly one of program or program_digest. Program grammar: bhms_describe {"topic":"program-grammar"}; it also comes with any refusal of a malformed program.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `program` | object | no | A bounded BHMS program. Grammar: bhms_describe {"topic":"program-grammar"}; a malformed program is refused with the failing step path and the grammar. |
| `program_digest` | string | no | sha256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON. |
| `arguments` | object | yes |  |
| `operation_key` | string | no | Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same key with identical arguments to retry safely. |
| `wait_ms` | integer | no | Milliseconds to wait for the outcome (default 5000, max 60000). |
